The mobile homepage shows the role, two-line name, value statement, body copy, both actions, caption, and credit within the 812-pixel viewport without horizontal clipping.
The desktop About capture shows the through-line, linked continuities, recursive method, and the start of the first project loop beneath the sticky navigation.
The mobile About capture shows the complete lineage and method beneath the sticky navigation, followed by the three-systems-loops introduction.
